subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Should maintainers require a fresh real iOS/WebChat live repro before allowing any new fix PR for this canonical no-reply issue?
rationale: The field evidence is strong, but current source shows the expected `chat.send` path and related fixes only partially overlap; choosing the next repair boundary needs proof that the native app still fails on a current build.

options.title: Require live iOS repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open and capture a paired native iOS send with gateway logs, `chat.send`/`agent.wait` telemetry, and transcript deltas before opening a new fix PR.

options.title: Fold into restart-recovery tracker
options.body: Move the remaining work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99346 only if live evidence shows the native failure is the same `agent:main:boot` route-ownership bug.

options.title: Close after package validation
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers prove the current beta or next stable package fixes the native iOS app path end to end, not just the generic reply-session conflict.

recommendation.title: Require live iOS repro first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and capture a paired native iOS send with gateway logs, `chat.send`/`agent.wait` telemetry, and transcript deltas before opening a new fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has adjacent WebChat route-history ownership.
